quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Uber Launches Baidu's Fully Driverless Apollo Go in Dubai, (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Baidu: Baidu's fully driverless Apollo Go vehicles became available to riders on the Uber platform in Dubai (fleet operator New Horizon Luxury Transport), initially in select locations in Umm Suqeim and Jumeirah - the first market of a multi-year strategic partnership, with Dubai the launchpad for scaling thousands of Apollo Go vehicles across Uber's global network; Uber calls it the first multi-partner autonomous network globally (company claim). The service uses Apollo Go's sixth-generation RT6, a purpose-built, fully electric robotaxi for up to three passengers with more than 30 sensors.
quarterly_data.figure: thousands of Apollo Go vehicles planned; sixth-generation RT6; more than 30 sensors per vehicle
